reason: Primary arXiv HTML, sections 1–4: FedNL learns client-local test-time memory adaptation rules using a fixed-size Titans-style memory state, Delta Rule updates, and federated aggregation. The paper frames adaptation/accuracy under non-IID data, not inference efficiency; no LLM deployment latency/KV-memory result is presented. Potential memory architecture adjacency is weak and compute overhead remains unquantified.
title: Federated Nested Learning: Collaborative Training of Self-Referential Memories for Test-Time Adaptation
